name: bvh-punchout-front-v1
about: Generic 2D cut-out skeleton for front-facing (Punch-Out style) fighters. L/R mean SCREEN left/right (L is the fighter's own right hand). Pivots here are reference values in a 534x1265 reference frame (Gavin); each skin.json may override pivots for its own art. Rotations in degrees, positive is clockwise on screen. Bone transform = parent * translate(pivot - parentPivot + anim.xy) * rotate(anim.rot) * scale(anim.sx, anim.sy). Bones with worldRotation ignore their parent's rotation (boots stay flat). Any bone track may carry z (1 to 9): a part with z > 0 is drawn in a raised-leg layer above every other leg part and below the pelvis, ordered by z (front kick uses thigh 3, shin 2, boot 1). This stays correct for mirrored anims. Boot tracks may carry follow (0 to 1): 0 keeps the boot level, 1 turns it with the shin (roundhouse).

ik.note: 2-bone IK puts the ankle (boot pivot) on the target; thigh/shin sy tracks foreshorten the leg (lengths scale with them)

slots.head: head incl. hat and beard, cut just under the beard
slots.torso: jacket and shirt, waist to collar, shoulders filled under the arms
slots.pelvis: belt to crotch, filled up under the jacket hem
slots.forearm_L: elbow to wrist sleeve (the forearm+fist limb is two layers so the fist can scale toward the camera on punches)
slots.forearm_R: elbow to wrist sleeve (the forearm+fist limb is two layers so the fist can scale toward the camera on punches)
slots.fist_L: fist incl. wraps/gloves and wrist, pivot at the wrist
slots.fist_R: fist incl. wraps/gloves and wrist, pivot at the wrist
slots.boot_L: boot, pivot at the ankle; worldRotation: stays level on the floor unless its own track rotates it
slots.boot_R: boot, pivot at the ankle; worldRotation: stays level on the floor unless its own track rotates it
